## Netflix - Software Engineer, L5 - Delivery

🔗 [Apply](https://netflix.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/netflix/job/usa---remote/software-engineer--l5----delivery_jr41284)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Software Engineer (L5) focusing on developer platforms handling software deployment at Netflix. Collaborating across teams to improve productivity and reliability of software delivery.
Software Engineer (L5) focusing on developer platforms at Netflix
- Salary: $388,000 - $619,000 per year
- Tech stack: Distributed Systems, Java, Spinnaker, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot
- Our team is primarily responsible for the developer platforms that roll out software and infrastructure changes to the entire Netflix fleet.
- We do this through our Continuous Delivery (CD) system Spinnaker, and our higher level declarative delivery-based platform, Managed Delivery.
- Some example goals for projects include: Reduce friction and time to deploy software across our internal fleet; Improve the reliability and safety of changes being rolled out.
- Experienced with Java or other JVM languages
- Have built distributed systems components.
- Able to break down complexity, iterate, and communicate progress to a wide variety of partners and stakeholders.
- Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation.
- Nice to Have: Ability to develop full stack and write front-end code when needed
- Familiarity with the Spring Boot framework
- Have worked on a developer platform team where other engineers were your customers.

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer (L5) focusing on developer platforms handling software deployment at Netflix. Collaborating across teams to improve productivity and reliability of software delivery.
Software Engineer (L5) focusing on developer platforms at Netflix
Role description:
• Our team is primarily responsible for the developer platforms that roll out software and infrastructure changes to the entire Netflix fleet.
• We do this through our Continuous Delivery (CD) system Spinnaker, and our higher level declarative delivery-based platform, Managed Delivery.
• Some example goals for projects include: Reduce friction and time to deploy software across our internal fleet; Improve the reliability and safety of changes being rolled out.
Role requirements:
• Experienced with Java or other JVM languages
• Have built distributed systems components.
• Able to break down complexity, iterate, and communicate progress to a wide variety of partners and stakeholders.
• Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation.
• Nice to Have: Ability to develop full stack and write front-end code when needed
• Familiarity with the Spring Boot framework
• Have worked on a developer platform team where other engineers were your customers.
Benefits:
• Health Plans
• Mental Health support
• 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match
• Stock Option Program
• Disability Programs
• Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
• Family-forming benefits
• Life and Serious Injury Benefits
• Paid leave of absence programs
• Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off
• Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off
Tech stack:
Distributed Systems, Java, Spinnaker, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot
